comment: Conventional cages were banned in 2012, when the UK was still part of the EU.
Norway is part of the European Economic Area, so conventional cages were banned in 2012 as well.
This source indicates Ukraine might have banned conventional cages from 2026. Other sources say it had high shares of battery cages until recently.
This source says that the deadline for the transition away from conventional cages was set to 2026 in Türkiye.

"Currently, there is a proposal that the conventional cages in the existing farms will be allowed until the country’s accession to the European Union (EU) while all new constructed farms must have enriched cages as a minimum welfare standard."
